name: featured3-grid
title: Featured3 Grid
description: Three tall AI feature cards on black, each with a photographic background and a live interactive surface. The first holds a frosted glass panel whose question-and-answer pair crossfades through a blur every four seconds; the second draws an SVG forecast chart that wipes in behind an animated clip-path with a marker that pops on the peak; the third builds a categorization tree whose connectors are measured from live DOM positions via ResizeObserver, with light pulses travelling along each path on a loop. Everything animates once the section scrolls into view.
